shots.focal_element: Seated presenter in a beige sweater at a desk, centre-right of frame, in a dark studio set with a Profound University sign and a Shure mic
shots.typography: No overlay text; only in-set signage: a backlit wall panel reading 'Profound University' and a dimensional desk logo 'Profound', both clean geometric sans, medium-bold weight, title case, normal tracking (brand typeface, font name not identifiable).
shots.what_happens: The shot resolves from a heavily blurred frame (first sampled frame fully defocused) into a sharp wide presenter shot; the presenter delivers the aside 'Oh, and one more thing' (w288-w292) with a small smile, hands clasped, then gestures briefly.
shots.build_rebuild: Crossfade from the previous UI shot into a locked-off wide presenter clip while animating a CSS/filter Gaussian blur from about 40px to 0 over the first ~0.4s.

shots.focal_element: Profound Sheets spreadsheet UI with collaborator avatars, highlighted cells and an 'LLM Response' side panel
shots.typography: Native product UI text: small neutral sans (system/Inter-like, low-confidence guess) in regular weight, sentence/title case, default tracking; column headers in medium weight with blue accent on agent columns; coloured name tags on multiplayer cursors (e.g. 'Garrett').
shots.what_happens: Opens from a blurred presenter frame into a full browser recording of a sheet; while VO says Sheets is fully collaborative (w293-w328), the camera punches in on the top-right avatar stack and 'Add column' button, then on rows where coloured cell highlights from other users appear and a persona cell is edited ('50-60 year old executive'), then a named collaborator cursor selects a row and an 'LLM Response' side panel opens with a streamed FAQ answer; ends on a wide view of the sheet plus panel.
shots.build_rebuild: Play a high-res screen capture of the sheet and drive a virtual camera with keyframed scale/translate punch-ins (avatar stack, highlighted rows, named cursor) synced to VO phrases, pulling back to the full frame for the side-panel reveal.

shots.focal_element: Seated presenter in the dark studio set, centre-right, Profound University sign behind
shots.typography: No overlay text; in-set backlit sign 'Profound University' and desk logo 'Profound' in the brand's geometric sans, medium-bold, title case.
shots.what_happens: Again resolves from a blurred frame into the wide presenter shot; he delivers 'Profound is no longer just an analytics tool' (w329-w336) with open-hand gestures; the last sampled frame already shows the tighter close-up angle that s021 continues.
shots.build_rebuild: Reuse the blur-to-sharp crossfade entry (filter blur ~40px to 0) onto the wide presenter take, cutting on the end of the sentence.

shots.focal_element: Presenter's face and shoulders in a tighter, slightly side-on close-up, framed left of centre with the mic and shelf logo on the right
shots.what_happens: A second camera angle (closer, off-axis, shallow depth of field with the background shelves and logo object softly out of focus) holds on the presenter as he delivers the positioning line 'It's a marketers modern workbench ... ship like a team of 10' (w337-w356); no graphics.
shots.build_rebuild: Hard-cut to a second-camera medium close-up shot at shallow depth of field for the key positioning line, with no overlays.

shots.focal_element: Seated presenter in the wide studio frame, slightly tighter/reframed versus s018 so the desk logo is cropped at the bottom edge
shots.typography: No overlay text; in-set 'Profound University' sign in geometric sans, medium-bold, title case; desk 'Profound' logo mostly cropped by the frame bottom.
shots.what_happens: Cut back to the front angle (slightly punched-in compared with the earlier wides) for the sign-off 'And Profound Sheets is just the beginning. Welcome to Marketing Built for the AI Era.' (w357-w371); presenter smiles, hands clasped, minimal movement.
shots.build_rebuild: Hard-cut back to the front camera with a ~10% digital punch-in on the wide take and hold it for the closing tagline before the end card.
